name: Inner Mongolia Xingye Silver & Tin Mining Co., Ltd
summary: Inner Mongolia Xingye Silver & Tin Mining Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the non-ferrous metal mining and beneficiation business in China and Mongolia. The company explores for silver, tin, zinc, lead, iron, copper, antimony, gold, and bismuth, as well as tungsten, other non-ferrous metals, precious metals, and black metals. It is also involved in the provision of technical services; and investment activities and trading activities. The company was formerly known as Inner Mongolia Xingye Mining Co., Ltd and changed its name to Inner Mongolia Xingye Silver & Tin Mining Co., Ltd in June 2023.
